method: Actually viewed boundary-contact-10.jpg through boundary-contact-18.jpg with view_image; additionally viewed individual decoded samples 0194, 0195, 0199 and 0253 at their stored 960x540 resolution.
scope: Bracket assembly and first labels, bracket-to-hip transition, independent hip disassembly/reassembly, central post/support labels, rafters and roof closing, hip-to-gravity transition, roof board-to-rafter-to-purlin contact/load route. claim_limit: This is an actual visual review of 162 sampled frames, not human continuous playback and not proof that every intervening frame has no pop or clipping. Timing finding combines decoded caption-bearing frames with the already inspected camera assembly curve.

findings.title: 斗栱抬层动作比说明晚了一句
findings.observation: 在112.53秒字幕“抬开这一层，看交叉的地方”和115.60秒“两根木头各让出位置，合起来才不会顶住”时，前左斗栱上部仍完整坐在交叉节点上，接头没有被揭开；119.07秒字幕已经变为“它把承托的位置向外伸”时，顶部构件才已离开，交叉面可见。
findings.source_corroboration: Reviewed World bracket assembly curve holds q=b during u=2 to3, and withdraws to q=.605 during u=3 to3.65. Locked narration asks to lift the layer in bracket line2.
findings.impact: 观众在被要求看互让缺口时看不到被上层遮住的接触关系，错过该榫卯原理的主要视觉证据。
findings.suggested_fix: 将抬开上层的装配区间移到bracket line2，并在这句后半保持交叉面可见；line3可保留观察支承宽度的运镜。保持前后镜头位置与q的连续性，修后回看line1末尾至line4。
findings.resolution: resolved after actual visual recheck of repaired final media; original observation retained
findings.original_resolution: open; reviewer did not change production source or media

resolution_evidence.result: The cap and upper crossing arm now lift during the matching explanation, exposing the crossing joint; open hold and subsequent reassembly are visible in sampled frames.

findings.title: 椽子入场短暂穿过品牌留白
findings.observation: 148.43秒入场中的椽子位于左上品牌文字背后，木材覆盖rainbow鱼末尾一部分背景，文字仍可辨认。
findings.impact: 短暂降低品牌区的留白与精致感，不影响榫卯机制理解。
findings.suggested_fix: 若此次继续调整该镜头，可稍改入场路径或相机横向构图，避免椽群经过品牌区域；无需为此缩小品牌文字。

positive_observations: 独立角梁段能在样帧中辨认同一根角梁先离座、外移、回到上方并落回，其余结构保持连续的参照。
角梁名称已经等到构件进入可见区才出现，样帧中没有画外引线。
短柱与托梁使用统一字号和柔和底托，文字在该组样帧中可读，未遮住核心接触位置。
hip-to-gravity转场的相邻边界样帧保持同一座完整亭子，没有直接替换为无关结构。
重力段望板、单根椽、檩的顺序与字幕一致，透视弱化周边结构后可以追踪同一根椽及其落脚位置。
主体保持暖木色与纸色背景；主要标签、字幕和章节标题没有新增杂乱字体体系。
